name: Follow the line
title: What do you need today?
note: Follow the line carousel posted; all verses checked
caption:
Follow your line, then tell us where it landed.

Whatever you are carrying into this day, God has something for it. He gives a peace the world cannot, strength when you feel worn thin, courage for what is ahead, and a straight path when you are not sure which way to go.

John 14:27, Proverbs 3:5-6, Joshua 1:9, Isaiah 40:29 (BSB)

Save this for the week ahead.
